summary: Sign/direction helper on a double argument. Computes v2 = a1 - a1 (a zeroed FPU quantity whose sign/zero status flags drive the result), negates v2 when the dword at dword_8D46B4 + 132 is zero, then returns 1, 0 or -1 according to the FPU comparison of v2 against 0.0. Two AudioMixerSampleGetWithFallback(0.0) calls precede the computation with unused results.

local_names.a1: double argument passed in ST0 whose sign/zero determines the result
local_names.v1: FPU status word captured by the comparison
local_names.v2: zeroed FPU quantity (a1 - a1), optionally negated by the dword_8D46B4+132 flag

operations.description: v2 = a1 - a1: a zeroed FPU value whose sign/zero status flags drive the subsequent return selection.
If the dword at dword_8D46B4 + 132 is zero, negate v2, reversing the polarity of the sign test.
Compare v2 against 0.0 and capture the FPU status-word bits (v1 & 0x4100) plus the less-than and zero compare flags.
If neither the zero nor the less-than bits of the FPU status word are set (v1 & 0x4100 == 0), return 1.
